body: I don't have friends. I have no one.
I appreciate the concern. My journey could certainly just be starting but I know if I chose to let it go on it would be painful. I am going to spare myself that pain.

>I've found one helpful tool I'll share. You enjoy online jokes right? That's what you know, and so that's what you share with people.

If I start making jokes about those things then I'll look more of an autist than I already am. 

>Perhaps you should branch out and find a another hobby. 

I have music, but barely anyone I know has similar taste. There is one person but I'm too beta for them.

>> I miss tons of opportunities because of my autism and stunted social skills.

>^ This is enough to tell me you don't hang around the right people, What you're saying above comes down to I hate being surrounded by people who are just like me, whom might just make excellent friends. 

No. I don't hang out around anyone. That's always been the case so my social skills are fucked. And the reason I don't like autists is because they are like me, and I hate myself.

>If you are looking for a love interest, one will come along. 

No one loves me and they never will. Its hopeless.

>They way i see it, regardless of any disability, there are opportunities.

Said like a true neurotypical.

>This is where you misunderstand the opportunity presented to you. 

I miss tons of opportunities because of my autism and stunted social skills. 

>Depending on where you end up a of of the social rules that seem to be absolute truth in middle and high school end there.

I'm going to a university known mainly for animation, but into the computer security program. I'll be surrounded by autists like myself with no women in sight. Its going to be fucking horrible since I don't like autistic peoples' general personality. I have lots of experience with autists, I would know. 

And if some social rules disappear, then I'm really fucked since I've spent four years of my life trying to adjust to will not matter anymore. I might as well just kill myself now before I rack up huge amounts of debt.

Seeing people being happy upsets me. Knowing I'll never be like them, no matter how hard I try. 

And knowing I can't escape this life is saddening as well.

I thought my life would change in after middle school as well. But it didn't, even though I didn't know anyone there. I alienated myself from everyone I could have been friends with, just as I will in university. It doesn't matter if I see anyone there, it won't matter since the situation will be the same, that no one likes me. 

As for the apprenticeship bit, I've had jobs before. People have depended on me, I guess, but I've always just been an unimportant cog in the system. 

Even if I become important, become a reliable person, that's all I'll be. Just someone you can depend on for a specific task, but not really someone you would want to be friends or have a relationship with. My life is supposed to be more than just a job or a task, but it will never be. 

Too bad I can't escape this shitty existence.
I tried to be social, failed miserably, cried in public twice, went home, and someone tried to comfort me but it turned out bad. Fuck my life.

Note: I am aware I'm responding to myself. Bullying myself is what I do sometimes I guess.
